To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a multivariate Gaussian distribution model of natural image patches can be learned from pristine natural images and used to evaluate the quality of image patches, and an overall image quality score can be obtained by average pooling the quality scores of all image patches.
an opinion-unaware method that integrates the features of natural scene statistics from multiple cues can compete with, or perhaps outperform, state-of-the-art BIQA methods.
a feature-enriched opinion-unaware BIQAE method can achieve consistently superior performance to the state of the art opinion-aware methods.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a novel opinion-unaware BIQI method, which is feature-rich and can compete with the opinion-aware BIQA algorithms.
developing an opinion-unaware blind image quality evaluator.
the following questions: (i) What are the most important image features for blind image quality assessment?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our method is the most promising opinion-unaware method for blind image quality assessment.
our proposed method is the best BIQA method in terms of both quality prediction accuracy and usability.
the proposed method can compete with, or even outperform, the state-of-the art opinion-aware BIQA method in quality prediction accuracy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed opinion-unaware method is able to compete with, if not outperform, the opinion-aware methods in terms of the quality-prediction accuracy.
we develop a feature-enriched completely blind image quality evaluator (ILNIQE) that is capable of consistently outperforming the opinion-aware BIQA algorithms.
we have developed a feature-enriched opinion-unaware BIQAE method that can outperform the state-of-the-arts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a feature-rich model of natural image statistics is a good starting point for developing an opinion-unaware image quality assessment algorithm.
, with a good feature representation and a good pooling scheme, an opinion-unaware method can achieve comparable performance to the opinion-aware methods.

, for a given set of training images with associated subjective scores, a good opinion-aware BIQA model may be learned from a subset of the training images with the rest of the training images used for testing, while an opinion-unaware model can be learned directly from the whole set of training images.
